newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares slide to close lower.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares slide to close lower.

text.p: Delhi shares shed early gains to close lower as late selling by profit-takers outweighed early buying by foreign institutional investors (FIIs), brokers said.
The indicative Delhi stock exchange index ended 2.68 points down at 789.37.
"Revival of early buying by FIIs in early trade was the only main feature of the session with the result that sentiment had improved to some extent," said Sanjay Mittal of brokers S.R.M. Securities.
Reliance Industries closed 0.65 rupee down at 208.50 while State Bank of India quoted 1.70 rupees higher at 280.20.
ITC ended three rupees up at 298.75. TISCO fell 1.70 rupees to 193.65.
Larsen and Toubro dropped 1.85 rupees to 250.50 while TELCO fell one rupee to close at 505.
